audience: agencies and service teams that run contacts, projects and tasks in Hubflo

useCases.title: Review contacts and companies
useCases.text: List contacts or companies with filters. Open one to read its tags.

useCases.title: Check projects and overdue tasks
useCases.text: List projects, then list tasks filtered by project, assignee, completion or overdue state.

useCases.title: Read invoices and flows
useCases.text: List invoices filtered by contact, project or status. List the running and finished flows, newest first.

useCases.title: Read form submissions
useCases.text: List the forms of the organization, then list the answers submitted to one form, filtered by contact or status.

useCases.title: Create a task or a note
useCases.text: Create a task linked to a project or contact. Create a note in the library, linked to projects or contacts.

useCases.title: Update a contact or a task
useCases.text: Change fields of one contact or one task, such as marking the task completed. Tags, when sent, replace the existing tags.
